content.title: 1 Stock Under $50 Worth Investigating and 2 We Avoid
content.summary: The $10-50 price range often includes mid-sized businesses with proven track records and plenty of growth runway ahead. They also usually carry less risk than penny stocks, though they’re not immune to volatility as many lack the scale advantages of their larger peers.

content.title: Gap Will Participate in Trump’s US Anniversary Celebration
content.summary: Unlike other corporate leaders, Gap Chief Executive Officer Richard Dickson hasn’t shied away from political conversation, encouraging employees to “share opinions” in a memo sent after the assassination of political commentator Charlie Kirk, Bloomberg News previously reported.  Dickson and his government affairs team have also spoken directly with Trump and his administration about tariffs.
